title: 100 Pokemon Cards incl. Holo Rares
description:
This listing is for 100 RANDOM cards from the latest Pokemon trading card expansions. Most of the cards will be from Scarlet & Violet expansions onwards.

These packs are great value for kickstarting or boosting your collection with a vast assortment of different types of cards.

Each stack pictured is a sample of the quantity and types of cards you may receive. This includes:
- MULTIPLE Holographic Rares
- along with rares/rev holos

**I personally stack all my bulk lots by hand to ensure you get a very good selection of different cards and not just piles of the same cards**
_______

All my cards are guaranteed 100% authentic and near-mint condition unless stated otherwise.

Please note: picture is for display purposes and is to give an idea of the cards you may receive, there are no guarantees for any specific cards.

Happy to combine shipping for multiple purchases
